sam_mobile: Hey support — after this morning's Android release (~canary 1.14.2) a subset of users are getting 401 invalid_api_key from the Hosted API. Happens on devices Android 9/10 mostly. Authorization header logged but server returns 401. Repro steps below.

support_raj: Can you paste the client request snippet and any raw header from device logs? Also which SDK + how are you storing the key?

sam_mobile: SDK v1.14.2. We store an API key in Android Keystore and persist as base64 in SharedPreferences. Here's the network snippet we use (sanitized):
```
val apiKey = loadKeyFromKeystore() // returns String
val req = Request.Builder()
  .url("https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate")
  .header("Authorization", "ApiKey $apiKey")
  .post(RequestBody.create(jsonMediaType, body))
  .build()
```
Log output (sanitized):
```
AUTH HEADER: ApiKey ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ123456==�
HEADER LEN: 44
SERVER RESP: 401 invalid_api_key
```

eng_tim: That trailing \u0000 looks like a null byte. Could be padding from keystore or a charset mismatch when converting bytes->String. Can you dump the raw bytes hex?

sam_mobile: We recently changed keystore storage to store base64 of the secret bytes. Keystore returns a byte[] and we do `String(bytes)` in a few places (oops). Hex dump from device:
```
hex: 41 42 43 44 45 46 47 48 49 4a 4b 4c 4d 4e 4f 50 51 52 53 54 55 56 57 3d 3d 00
``` 
Note the trailing 00.

support_raj: If curl with that same header shows 401 but copying the value from your admin UI (which trims) works, that confirms client-side mangling. Suggest you try `new String(bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)` and also `trim()` and validate regex /^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{24,}$/ for base64-ish keys.

sam_mobile: Verified: some devices returned bytes in UTF-16LE default charset path, so `new String(bytes)` produced NULs when later re-encoded. Quick fix: explicitly decode to UTF-8 and strip control chars before storing. We'll ship 1.14.3 with a defensive validation and safer keystore helper.

support_raj: Do you want us to rotate the affected API key now? Also we'll add a temporary grace window if you need to roll clients.

sam_mobile: Please rotate now — seeing ~3% of requests failing in prod. Also a short grace window would help while app updates propagate.

support_raj: Rotating key now, will allow old key for 5m grace. pinging @eng_tim for SDK follow-up.

deploy-bot: Key rotation for org-abc executed at 6187654380 by support_raj — new key active; old key valid until 6187654680.

sam_mobile: Confirmed — new key + 1.14.3 build (with explicit UTF-8 decode) works, failures dropped to 0.5%. Thanks :tada:

eng_tim: I'll open an internal action item to add a runtime check in the SDK to reject keys with control chars and add a devdoc note about keystore byte handling.
